summary: Ericsson filed a Form 6-K announcing weekly share buybacks from August 10-14, 2026, under a SEK 15 billion program announced April 16, 2026, running through March 31, 2027. It repurchased 2.5 million Class B shares at a weighted average price of SEK 96.7017, totaling approximately SEK 241.75 million. The Board intends to propose cancellation of repurchased shares (except those for incentive programs) to the 2027 AGM. Transactions executed on Nasdaq Stockholm by Goldman Sachs Bank Europe SE. Watch for cumulative buyback progress and potential cancellation proposal impact on share count.
